acceptanceCriteria: go-product on main finishes with at least 25% headroom under its job timeout, measured on three consecutive main runs.
The change is a .github/ change merged under decision 0390 (owner posts ci-control-plane success).
body: Filed 2026-09-25. The go-product job (.github/workflows/ci.yml:45, timeout-minutes: 75) already takes about 71 of 75 minutes on main. PR #245 hit the limit twice when internal/tasks/authority got slower on ext4 (fixed in 13e1ebd3 by not re-reading mountinfo on each fixture re-check), and any package that grows a few minutes will do the same. Options: shard go test ./... across a matrix of jobs by package list, split -race packages from the rest, or raise the limit. Sharding also shortens wall-clock time per PR. Per-package durations are available from go test -json in the job log.
title: go-product CI job runs within 4 minutes of its 75-minute limit
